comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Chimera (9-knob). The guitar as the voice source of a simulated throat and mouth (talkbox-like): named after and built on the Chimera voice synth (github.com/jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth, MIT, (c) 2026 Jameson Hodge): a 16-section airway with a nasal branch, vowel shapes fitted to measured formants (design.py). Move is a named-step knob (labels: build/selector_metadata.py); the rest are 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x01A2. In this project's reserved 403-499 Delay block, next to Deform; free in every group's DB entry. Check repeat98's FXID registry before release.

params.name: Vowel
params.comment: params[5]. The mouth's shape: u, o, a, e, i from 0 to 100, morphing between.

params.name: Open
params.comment: params[6]. Jaw and lips: closed (a hum, with Nasal) to wide open.

params.name: Body
params.comment: params[7]. The throat's length: 19 cm (big) to 13.5 cm (small); 30 is an adult man.

params.name: Nasal
params.comment: params[8]. Opens the soft palate into the nose.

params.name: Talk
params.comment: params[9]. How far Move moves the mouth.

params.name: Move
params.comment: params[10]. Named steps Pick, Slow, Fast, Chat: the mouth follows each note, sways slowly or quickly, or babbles.

params.name: Buzz
params.comment: params[11]. Drives the guitar into a soft clipper first: more harmonics for the mouth to shape.

params.name: Breath
params.comment: params[12]. Air noise through the throat, following your playing: a whisper.
